pk.context: 7.5 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

pill.desc: pastel yellow, uncoated, round biconvex tablet

tell: A second concentration peak at 12 to 14 hours, from biliary recycling, sets this NSAID apart.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is 89%, and a high-fat meal raises peak levels about 22% without changing total exposure. It is 99.4% protein bound and cleared mainly by hepatic metabolism.
Molecular weight 351.4, and it is practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA in two strengths, 7.5 mg and 15 mg, and reaches steady state by day 5 of dosing.
Boxed warning on serious cardiovascular and gastrointestinal events. Contraindicated around bypass graft surgery and after aspirin allergy; abdominal pain and vomiting are common.
Relief of the signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis, and of juvenile rheumatoid arthritis in patients weighing at least 60 kg.
It involves inhibition of cyclooxygenase, COX-1 and COX-2, which reduces prostaglandin synthesis; the precise action is not completely understood.
The generic name begins with M and has nine letters.
